The modification in `Shell.java` specifically addresses the bug identified in issue ACCUMULO-3229 by altering the way authorization timeout values are formatted for output. The change enhances clarity by presenting the timeout as a whole number of seconds, which is more appropriate for displaying time durations that are typically represented in whole seconds, thereby improving the accuracy and readability of the output.
